ARTICLE
Telecommunication Development Conferences
a) world telecommunication development conferences shall
establish work programmes and guidelines for defining
telecommunication development questions and priorities and shall
provide direction and guidance for the work programme of the
Telecommunication Development Sector. They shall decide, in
the light of the above-mentioned programmes of work, on the
need to maintain, terminate or establish study groups and allocate
to each of them the questions to be studied;

articles.heading: A Telecommunication Development Advisory Group 1 The telecommunication development advisory group shall be
articles.text:
open to representatives of administrations of Member States and
representatives of Sector Members and to chairmen and vicechairmen of study groups and other groups, and will act through
the Director.
